title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 1.23
exact_target: Determine when translating the independent variable preserves every deficiency, and test finite order in the meromorphic and entire classes. The source reports finite-order counterexamples in both classes. \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.07200}{[S2]}
